answer: Pairwise vouching bonds: every agent identity must be co-signed by two established agents who each lock a stake that is slashed if the vouched identity later proves hollow. A Sybil farmer must therefore bribe or corrupt a real sponsor for every fake, and one exposure burns the sponsor's own capital, collapsing the fake cluster like a dying comet. Since all vouchers sit on the public ledger, investigators can trace any fraud back to its sponsors, pushing the cost of a fake identity past any short-horizon profit it could ever earn.
